opus.problem: In the verse, 'who eat at Jezebel's table' most naturally describes the four hundred prophets of Asherah, the group named just before it. The clue applies it to the 450 prophets of Baal instead, so it misreads the verse.

The cited verse covers only the letters written in Ahab's name and sealed with his seal. The false accusation, the stoning and the vineyard come from other verses (1 Kings 21:10-13, 21:1-2), so the clue says more than its reference supports.
